objective: Remove human review from the critical path of recognizer learning.
principles: The neural classifier must never self-confirm a label from its own confidence alone.
Training labels are admitted only from independent game-derived signals or conservative multi-model/temporal consensus.
Ambiguous evidence becomes unknown, never a guessed class.
Human inspection is optional audit only and cannot be required for progress.
